item.title: Shikigami
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Akabei Soft2 TRY
  • 発売日: 2011-07-29
  • スコア: 7.38/10 (59 人評価)
  • 日本語名: シキガミ
  • 英語名: Shikigami

あらすじ

In the capital during the Heian era, there was a onmyouji named Douman who doesn’t fare too well in his studies. However, the talented noblewoman Michinaga told him that everyone is unique and he should be himself. Because of this, he continued to study hard and vowed to protect her. The most powerful onmyouji Senmei told him that he is useless and is just a burden to everyone else in the world, and end up taking Michinaga away from him. He devised a stupid plan to oppose her, but how can the weakest guy like him defeat a genius like her? On top of that, suspected of planning an assassination against Michinaga, he was driven from the city. Now alone except for with Michinaga’s cousin Akimitsu, who is just as dumb as he is, how will he be able to gain revenge against Senmei?

item.title: Ore-sama no RagnaRock
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Akabei Soft2 TRY
  • 発売日: 2010-10-28
  • スコア: 6.67/10 (47 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 俺サマのラグナRock
  • 英語名: Ore-sama no RagnaRock

あらすじ

A long time ago, there was a great war known as Ragnarok where many Gods and Demons were thought to have perished. Now in the northern most part of Japan, the demon lord Njord spends his day being irritated. Is it because of his poverty? Well, that too… but it’s because of those ‘Gods’ on TV. The Gods were the ones that actually won the war and now they’re all over the TV, singing their heavenly songs. He can’t take it anymore and drags his imouto Nerthus along to fight against the Gods in a battle of songs. This is a new Ragnarok… no, RagnaRock!
